Where to find your %s API key: Inda za a sami maɓallin API na %s ɗinku
Connect a mailing-list service once; the: Haɗa sabis ɗin lissafin aika saƙo sau ɗaya; sannan kowane fom zai iya ƙara mutanen da suka cika shi zuwa ɗaya daga cikin jerin sunayenku (saitunan toshewar fom → Bayan aikawa). Ana bincika makullan tare da sabis ɗin, a adana su a ɓoye a wannan rukunin yanar gizon kuma ba za a sake nuna su ba.
Send form submissions and button clicks: Aika bayanan fom da dannawar madanni zuwa nazarin bayananku ba tare da rubuta lamba ba. Bar ID a sarari don tsallake waccan sabis ɗin. Madannai suna samun filin "Conversion event" a sashinsu na Advanced. Tare da kunna allon kuki, babu abin da zai loda har sai maziyari ya amince.
Google Tag Manager container ID: ID ɗin akwati na Google Tag Manager
Meta Pixel ID (the number shown in Meta: ID na Meta Pixel (lambar da aka nuna a Meta Events Manager)
Switch off if your theme or another plug: Kashe idan jigarku ko wani plugin ya riga ya ƙara su; ana ci gaba da aika al'amuran.
Event name for form submissions: Sunan aukuwa don ƙaddamar da fom
The banner is a popup you design with bl: Banner ɗin wani popup ne da kuke tsarawa ta hanyar amfani da tubalan ginawa (blocks). Maballan sa suna haɗawa da #consent-accept, #consent-reject da #consent-save (tare da akwatunan zaɓe masu suna analytics da marketing don "save"); hanyar haɗi zuwa #consent-open a kowane wuri tana sake nuna shi. Har sai maziyarci ya yarda, alamun bibiya ba sa lodi, Yanayin Yarda na Google (Google Consent Mode) yana kasancewa a matsayin "denied", kuma rubutun da kuka lissafa suna kasancewa a kashe.
Create a ready-made banner: Ƙirƙiri tutar da aka riga aka shirya
Remember the choice for (days): Ka tuna da zaɓin na tsawon (kwanaki)
Outside the European Union, the EEA and: A wajen Tarayyar Turai, EEA da Birtaniya: loda bin sawu har sai mai ziyara ya ce a'a
Off: every visitor must agree first (the: Kashe: dole ne kowane mai ziyara ya fara yarda (dokar da ta fi tsauri, kuma ita ce ta asali). Kunna: kawai lokacin da mai masaukin ku ko CDN ya ba da rahoton ƙasar mai ziyara (misali Cloudflare ta CF-IPCountry header) kuma tana wajen EU, EEA, UK da Switzerland. Har yanzu ana nuna allon sanarwar, kuma ana ɗaukar ƙasar da ba a sani ba a matsayin tana cikin EU.
Other scripts to hold until consent (han: Sauran rubutun da za a riƙe har sai an sami yarda (handle:analytics ko handle:marketing, an raba da waƙafi)
Popups, slide-ins and bars: Tagogi masu tashi, masu zamewa da kuma sanduna
Guides: forms, popups, motion, tracking,: Jagorori: fom-fom, fafutoci, motsi, bibiya, gwaje-gwajen A/B da kuma allon sanarwar kuki
